# Local common parameter-declaration candidate

[candidate-01.md](candidate-01.md) records the read-only comparison and the
smallest proposed common-AST declaration-name checking unit.
[source-inputs.json](source-inputs.json) identifies the inspected subset;
[context.json](context.json) distinguishes observation, prediction and pending
policy. The normalized [Issue #32 connector snapshot](issue-32.connector.json)
retains the actual decision context. No original HTTP-byte identity or human
adoption is asserted.

No proposed source check, build, tests, CLI/native execution, production edit,
existing metadata update, Git/Issue mutation, proof or completion is performed.
The first-file map freezes this local non-normative candidate only; it is not
runtime closure or compiled-source attestation. Later concrete source/validation
experiments require their own preserved records and parent coordination.
